title: 00_ecobank_context.txt
text:
Ecobank general context (plain text)

Ecobank is a leading pan-African banking group (ETI), founded in 1985 and headquartered in Lomé, Togo.
It operates in 30+ African countries with Nigeria and Ghana as key markets.
Core services: retail, corporate, and digital banking. Strong focus on mobile/USSD, financial inclusion, and KYC/AML compliance.
Customer support is available in English and French. This corpus targets typical chat interactions and account-opening issues.

ETI has an affiliate in France, and representative offices in China, Dubai, South Africa, and the United Kingdom.

History
Ecobank was founded in 1985 to address the financial needs of West African entrepreneurs. Example 1
User: What is Ecobank Xpress Account?
Bot: The Xpress Account is a lightweight, mobile‑friendly account type with lower fees and sometimes no minimum balance, ideal for customers who want simple access.

Example 2
User: Can I open Xpress account online?
Bot: Yes, in many regions. You’ll fill the application form in app or USSD, upload required documents, then activate account once documents pass verification.

title: topic40_form_downloads_indemnity.txt
text:
Topic: 40_form_downloads_indemnity

Example 1
User: Where can I download the Ecobank account opening form?
Bot: You can get it on Ecobank’s website under “Form Downloads” — the Individual / Joint / Deed of Indemnity etc.

Example 2
User: What is a Deed of Indemnity?
Bot: It’s a compulsory document that you sign to indemnify the bank against false statements or fraud. Ecobank provides it alongside account opening forms.

title: topic41_selfie_no_face.txt
text:
Topic: 41_selfie_no_face

Example 1
User: The system says my selfie has no face detected. What should I do?
Bot: Please retake the selfie in good lighting, make sure your whole face is visible, and avoid hats or glasses.

Example 2
User: My photo keeps being rejected as no face found.
Bot: Try positioning your face directly in front of the camera, ensure the background is clear, and upload again.

title: topic42_cancel_application.txt
text:
Topic: 42_cancel_application

Example 1
User: I want to cancel my Ecobank account opening request.
Bot: You can cancel by not completing the application. Incomplete applications are automatically closed after 30 days.

Example 2
User: Can I withdraw my application after submission?
Bot: Yes, contact Ecobank support with your reference number to request cancellation.

title: topic43_corporate_timing.txt
text:
Topic: 43_corporate_timing

Example 1
User: How long does it take to open a corporate account?
Bot: Corporate account opening can take 5–10 business days depending on document verification and compliance checks.

Example 2
User: Why is my company account opening taking longer?
Bot: Business accounts undergo enhanced due diligence, so the process may take additional time.

title: topic44_foreign_customers.txt
text:
Topic: 44_foreign_customers

Example 1
User: Can a foreigner open an Ecobank account?
Bot: Yes, but you must provide a valid passport, residence permit, and proof of local address.

Example 2
User: I am an expat in Nigeria, what documents are required?
Bot: Passport, residence/work permit, and a utility bill or tenancy agreement in your name are needed.

title: topic45_multi_currency.txt
text:
Topic: 45_multi_currency

Example 1
User: Can I open a multi‑currency account at Ecobank?
Bot: Yes, Ecobank offers accounts in local and foreign currencies like USD, EUR, GBP depending on the country.

Example 2
User: How many currencies can I hold at once?
Bot: You can maintain multiple currency sub‑accounts linked under your main profile.

title: topic46_mobile_money.txt
text:
Topic: 46_mobile_money

Example 1
User: Can I link my Ecobank account with MTN Mobile Money?
Bot: Yes, Ecobank supports linking to mobile money services. Use the mobile app or USSD to connect.

Example 2
User: Can I transfer money from Airtel Money to Ecobank?
Bot: Yes, transfers between Ecobank and Airtel Money are supported in several countries.

title: topic47_minimum_age.txt
text:
Topic: 47_minimum_age

Example 1
User: What is the minimum age to open an Ecobank account?
Bot: The minimum age is 18. Minors can open accounts with a guardian as signatory.

Example 2
User: Can a 17‑year‑old open a student account?
Bot: Yes, but a parent or guardian must co‑sign and provide supporting documents.

title: topic48_session_timeout.txt
text:
Topic: 48_session_timeout

Example 1
User: The system logs me out with “session timeout.”
Bot: Please log in again and ensure you complete the form promptly. Save progress if possible.

Example 2
User: Why does my application expire quickly?
Bot: For security, sessions expire after inactivity. Keep documents ready before starting.

title: topic49_sanctions_check.txt
text:
Topic: 49_sanctions_check

Example 1
User: My application is under sanctions review. What does it mean?
Bot: Ecobank must check applicants against international sanction lists. If flagged, processing may be delayed.

Example 2
User: Can I speed up a sanctions review?
Bot: Unfortunately no, this step is mandatory for compliance and must be completed before approval.

title: topic50_country_restrictions.txt
text:
Topic: 50_country_restrictions

Example 1
User: Can I open an account from any country?
Bot: Ecobank operates in 35+ African countries. If you apply outside these, restrictions apply.

Example 2
User: I live in a non‑Ecobank country. What are my options?
Bot: You may be able to open a Diaspora account remotely if requirements are met.

title: topic51_debit_card_speed.txt
text:
Topic: 51_debit_card_speed

Example 1
User: How fast can I get my debit card after account opening?
Bot: Debit cards are usually ready within 5–7 business days after account approval.

Example 2
User: Can my debit card be delivered?
Bot: In some regions, Ecobank offers card delivery; otherwise collect at your branch.

title: topic52_application_notifications.txt
text:
Topic: 52_application_notifications

Example 1
User: Will I get SMS updates on my application?
Bot: Yes, Ecobank sends SMS or email notifications at each stage of the review.

Example 2
User: I didn’t receive any update after submission.
Bot: Check that your phone number and email are correct. If not, contact support.

title: topic53_email_confirmation_error.txt
text:
Topic: 53_email_confirmation_error

Example 1
User: My email confirmation link doesn’t work.
Bot: Please request a new confirmation email from the login page.

Example 2
User: I clicked the link but it says expired.
Bot: Confirmation links expire after 24 hours. Request a new one to proceed.

title: topic54_employment_letter.txt
text:
Topic: 54_employment_letter

Example 1
User: Do I need an employment letter to open an account?
Bot: For regular savings accounts no, but some premium accounts may require proof of employment or income.

Example 2
User: Can I use my student ID instead?
Bot: Yes, for student accounts, school ID plus guardian details are acceptable.

title: topic55_kyc_explanation.txt
text:
Topic: 55_kyc_explanation

Example 1
User: What is KYC?
Bot: KYC means Know Your Customer. It’s the process of verifying your identity and documents before account approval.

Example 2
User: Why is KYC important?
Bot: It ensures compliance with anti‑fraud and anti‑money‑laundering regulations.

title: topic56_update_address.txt
text:
Topic: 56_update_address

Example 1
User: I moved to a new house. How do I update my address?
Bot: Please upload a new proof of address document in the portal or visit your branch.

Example 2
User: My bill still has the old address.
Bot: You must submit a new utility bill or tenancy agreement for the new address.

title: topic57_pensioner_requirements.txt
text:
Topic: 57_pensioner_requirements

Example 1
User: Can a retired person open an account?
Bot: Yes, retirees can open accounts with a valid pension ID and proof of address.

Example 2
User: What documents are needed for pensioners?
Bot: National ID/passport plus pensioner ID card are typically required.

title: topic58_no_smartphone.txt
text:
Topic: 58_no_smartphone

Example 1
User: Can I open an account without a smartphone?
Bot: Yes, you can use USSD codes or visit a branch for account opening.

Example 2
User: I don’t have internet access. Is it possible?
Bot: Yes, offline methods like USSD and paper forms are available.

title: topic59_ussd_application.txt
text:
Topic: 59_ussd_application

Example 1
User: Can I open an Ecobank account with USSD?
Bot: Yes, dial *326# in Nigeria and follow the instructions.

Example 2
User: What documents are required for USSD accounts?
Bot: Basic details are collected; for higher tiers you will later need ID and proof of address.

title: topic60_xpress_account_limits.txt
text:
Topic: 60_xpress_account_limits

Example 1
User: What are the limits for Ecobank Xpress accounts?
Bot: Daily transaction and balance limits apply, depending on tier. Example: ₦300,000 max balance in Nigeria.

Example 2
User: Can I upgrade my Xpress account?
Bot: Yes, by submitting full KYC documents you can remove limits.

title: topic61_tiered_accounts.txt
text:
Topic: 61_tiered_accounts

Example 1
User: What are tiered accounts?
Bot: Accounts with different transaction and balance limits depending on level of KYC completed.

Example 2
User: How do I move to a higher tier?
Bot: Provide additional KYC documents like ID, proof of address, and BVN.

title: topic62_incomplete_application_expiry.txt
text:
Topic: 62_incomplete_application_expiry

Example 1
User: How long does my incomplete application stay active?
Bot: Incomplete applications are saved for up to 30 days before being closed.

Example 2
User: Can I resume an old application after 30 days?
Bot: No, you must start a new application if the old one expired.

title: topic63_close_account.txt
text:
Topic: 63_close_account

Example 1
User: How do I close my Ecobank account?
Bot: Visit your branch with a valid ID and fill a closure form.

Example 2
User: Can I close my account online?
Bot: Currently closure must be requested at a branch for verification.

title: topic64_income_proof.txt
text:
Topic: 64_income_proof

Example 1
User: Do I need proof of income to open an account?
Bot: For savings accounts no, for current or premium accounts yes, salary slips or tax forms may be requested.

Example 2
User: What if I am self‑employed?
Bot: Provide business registration and bank statements as proof of income.

title: topic65_passport_crop_error.txt
text:
Topic: 65_passport_crop_error

Example 1
User: My passport upload was rejected as cropped. Why?
Bot: The full ID page must be visible. Please rescan and upload again.

Example 2
User: Only half of my ID shows. What can I do?
Bot: Resubmit a complete image without cutting off any part.

title: topic66_birthdate_mismatch.txt
text:
Topic: 66_birthdate_mismatch

Example 1
User: The birthdate on my form and ID don’t match.
Bot: Please correct the application form to match your official ID.

Example 2
User: Will small errors cause rejection?
Bot: Yes, mismatched birthdates require clarification before approval.

title: topic67_joint_account.txt
text:
Topic: 67_joint_account

Example 1
User: Can we open a joint account?
Bot: Yes, Ecobank offers joint accounts for two or more people with shared access.

Example 2
User: What documents are required?
Bot: IDs and proof of address for all parties, plus signatures on a joint application form.

title: topic68_student_account.txt
text:
Topic: 68_student_account

Example 1
User: What is required for a student account?
Bot: School ID, admission letter, and guardian details are usually needed.

Example 2
User: Is there an age restriction?
Bot: Student accounts are typically for ages 16–25, with guardian consent if under 18.

title: topic69_fees_charges.txt
text:
Topic: 69_fees_charges

Example 1
User: What are the account charges?
Bot: Savings accounts have minimal fees; current accounts may have maintenance fees depending on region.

Example 2
User: Do Xpress accounts have charges?
Bot: Xpress accounts often have zero maintenance fees but transaction fees may apply.

title: topic70_no_utility_bill.txt
text:
Topic: 70_no_utility_bill

Example 1
User: I don’t have a utility bill. What can I use?
Bot: You can provide a tenancy agreement, bank statement, or certificate of residence.

Example 2
User: Can I use my employer’s letter?
Bot: In some cases, an employer letter confirming address is accepted.

title: topic71_guarantor_requirement.txt
text:
Topic: 71_guarantor_requirement

Example 1
User: Do I need a guarantor to open a savings account?
Bot: No, guarantors are not required for personal savings accounts.

Example 2
User: What about for loans?
Bot: Loan products may require guarantors, but not basic account opening.

title: topic72_reference_number.txt
text:
Topic: 72_reference_number

Example 1
User: What is a reference number?
Bot: It is a unique identifier for your application used to track progress.

Example 2
User: Where can I find it?
Bot: It is sent to you by SMS/email after submission of your application.

title: topic73_remote_opening.txt
text:
Topic: 73_remote_opening

Example 1
User: Can I open an account fully online?
Bot: Yes, many accounts can be opened remotely on the https://aop.ecobank.com without branch visits.

Example 2
User: Is a video call required?
Bot: In some cases, remote video KYC is used for identity verification.

title: topic74_passport_validity.txt
text:
Topic: 74_passport_validity

Example 1
User: My passport expires in 2 months. Can I still use it?
Bot: IDs must be valid. If close to expiry, you may be asked to renew.

Example 2
User: Is an expired ID accepted?
Bot: No, only valid IDs are accepted for account opening.

title: topic75_credit_history.txt
text:
Topic: 75_credit_history

Example 1
User: Does my credit history affect account opening?
Bot: Generally no, but it may affect loan eligibility after account opening.

Example 2
User: Can bad credit prevent an account?
Bot: Basic accounts are usually unaffected by credit score.

title: topic76_processing_time.txt
text:
Topic: 76_processing_time

Example 1
User: How long is processing after submission?
Bot: Standard accounts: 2–5 business days. Corporate accounts: 5–10 days.

Example 2
User: Why is it still under review?
Bot: High volume or extra compliance checks can extend processing time.

title: topic77_sms_code_missing.txt
text:
Topic: 77_sms_code_missing

Example 1
User: I didn’t get the SMS code. What now?
Bot: Check your phone number is correct and has network coverage. Request a new code.

Example 2
User: Can I receive code by email instead?
Bot: Codes are primarily sent by SMS, some services may support email fallback.

title: topic78_child_account.txt
text:
Topic: 78_child_account

Example 1
User: Can I open an account for my child?
Bot: Yes, child/minor accounts require parent/guardian ID and the child’s birth certificate.

Example 2
User: At what age can children hold accounts?
Bot: From birth, with guardian until 18 years.

title: topic79_contact_support.txt
text:
Topic: 79_contact_support

Example 1
User: How do I contact Ecobank for help?
Bot: Use the support contacts on Ecobank’s website, via phone, email, or in‑app chat.

Example 2
User: Can I chat directly with an agent?
Bot: Yes, Ecobank provides live chat in the mobile app and on the website.

title: topic80_business_online_account.txt
text:
Topic: 80_business_online_account

Example 1
User: Can I open a business account online?
Bot: Yes, Ecobank allows online initiation of business accounts, but document submission and verification may require branch follow‑up.

Example 2
User: What documents are needed for business accounts?
Bot: Business registration, tax ID, and IDs for signatories are required.
